newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ANZ Bank NZ full yr profit falls 6.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: ANZ Bank NZ full yr profit falls 6.2 pct.

text.p: ANZ Bank New Zealand on Wednesday reported a tax-paid profit of NZ$157.3 million for the year ended September 30, 1996, down 6.2 percent from last year's $167.7 million profit.
ANZ in New Zealand includes the ANZ Banking Group (New Zealand) Ltd, operating under the ANZ and PostBank brands, and the UDC group of companies.
The bank said it had recorded good growth in lending, with total lending up 13 percent from NZ$13.3 billion to $15.0 billion.
Assets increased overall by 14 percent to $20 billion.
The bank said UDC recorded an after-tax profit of $33.6 million, up 7.4 percent on the previous year.
